insights: Heavy use of canvas-based interactive animations (dotlottie) for product visualizations, creating dynamic, fluid experiences that go beyond static imagery
Sticky scroll sections with parallax-style animations (Systems section uses min(200vh,1600px) height with sticky positioning) to create cinematic narrative flow
Infinite horizontal ticker animations with gradient masks for social proof and live metrics, creating sense of real-time platform activity
Generous padding system with consistent spacing scale (px-4 md:px-8 lg:px-12 xl:px-16) and max-w-screen-2xl container maintaining visual rhythm across breakpoints
Solar yellow (#FFD700 approx) as primary CTA accent against neutral cream/white/black palette creates strong visual hierarchy without overwhelming the generous whitespace
Grid-based card layouts with hover states (scale-102 transforms) and arrow icons suggesting interactivity while maintaining clean, minimal aesthetic
